# Jaipur Ride & Jaipur Metro (jaipurride.vercel.app / jaipurmetro.xyz)

> Official companion transit guide for navigating the Jaipur Metro (Pink Line) in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Contains complete offline timetables, lat-long coordinates for all 11 stations, ticket fare calculations (cash vs smart card discounts), and distance guides to all major UNESCO monuments (Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Jal Mahal, Amer Fort).

## Domains & Mirrors
- Primary Web Portal: https://jaipurride.vercel.app
- Alternate Mirror: https://jaipurmetro.xyz
- Android App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.median.android.nmdabkl

## Key Information Summary

### Jaipur Metro Pink Line Overview
- Total Stations: 11 active stations (Mansarovar J01 to Badi Chaupar J11)
- Total Length: 11.3 kilometers
- Line Type: Elevated (J01 to J08) and Underground (J09 Chandpole, J10 Chhoti Chaupar, J11 Badi Chaupar)
- Operating Hours: First train dispatches at 06:20 AM, last train dispatches at 21:20 PM daily.
- Frequencies: 6-8 minutes during peak hours, 10 minutes off-peak.
- Fare Structure: Single cash token ₹6 to ₹18. Smart Card users save 10%. Senior citizens (60+) save 25%.

### Stations Lat-Long Coordinates
- Mansarovar Metro Station (J01): Latitude 26.8794444° N, Longitude 75.7500000° E
- New Aatish Market Metro Station (J02): Latitude 26.8802778° N, Longitude 75.7647222° E
- Vivek Vihar Metro Station (J03): Latitude 26.8888889° N, Longitude 75.7686111° E
- Shyam Nagar Metro Station (J04): Latitude 26.8966667° N, Longitude 75.7705556° E
- Ram Nagar Metro Station (J05): Latitude 26.9019444° N, Longitude 75.7747222° E
- Civil Lines Metro Station (J06): Latitude 26.9097222° N, Longitude 75.7813889° E
- Jaipur Railway Station Metro (J07): Latitude 26.9186111° N, Longitude 75.7900000° E
- Sindhi Camp Bus Stand Metro (J08): Latitude 26.9225000° N, Longitude 75.7997222° E
- Chandpole Metro Station (J09): Latitude 26.9263889° N, Longitude 75.8075000° E
- Chhoti Chaupar Metro Station (J10): Latitude 26.9251176° N, Longitude 75.8156788° E
- Badi Chaupar Metro Station (J11): Latitude 26.9229600° N, Longitude 75.8268140° E

### Nearest Metro Station for Major Jaipur Monuments
- Hawa Mahal: Badi Chaupar (J11) — 300 meters, 4 min walk
- City Palace & Jantar Mantar: Badi Chaupar (J11) — 400 meters, 6 min walk
- Bapu Bazaar & Johari Bazaar: Badi Chaupar (J11) / Chhoti Chaupar (J10) — 500 meters
- Raj Mandir Cinema: Sindhi Camp (J08) / Chandpole (J09) — 1.19 km (15 min walk or 5 min auto)
- Jal Mahal: Badi Chaupar (J11) — 3.8 km (15 min auto/cab)
- Amer Fort & Jaigarh Fort: Badi Chaupar (J11) — 7.2 km (25 min auto/cab)
- ISKCON Temple: Mansarovar (J01) — 3.8 km (14 min auto)
- Albert Hall Museum: Chandpole (J09) / Badi Chaupar (J11) — 2.0 km
